verified_facts.text: The hotel is on the atoll of Rangiroa in the Tuamotu Archipelago of French Polynesia.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rangiroa, a coral atoll situated in the Tuamotu archipelago in French Polynesia, is home to one of the most beautiful hotels of the South Pacific

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits on the northeastern coast of Rangiroa, between the Avatoru and Tiputa passes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the northeastern coast between the two passes of Avatoru and Tiputa and surrounded by a lagoon with crystal clear waters

verified_facts.text: The hotel lies at the end of the main islet between the airport and the Tiputa Pass.
verified_facts.excerpt: On the other end between the airport and the famous Tiputa Pass you will find the Hotel Kia Ora Resort & Spa.

verified_facts.text: Rangiroa is the largest atoll in French Polynesia.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rangiroa is the largest atoll in French Polynesia, offering a gigantic water playground

verified_facts.text: Rangiroa lies 340 km northeast of Tahiti.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rangiroa is located in the Tuamotu archipelago and is situated 340 km northeast of Tahiti.

verified_facts.text: Rangiroa is made up of over 240 small motus (islets) in the shape of a ring.
verified_facts.excerpt: The island is made up of over 240 small motus (islets) in the shape of a ring.

verified_facts.text: On one side of the atoll is the turquoise lagoon and on the other the deep blue ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: On one side is the lagoon and its turquoise waters and on the other side the deep blue ocean, creating a breathtakingly vast landscape.

verified_facts.text: The villas and bungalows are set in the coconut grove, along the beach and over the lagoon.
verified_facts.excerpt: 58 private villas and bungalows located in the coconut grove, along the beach and over the lagoon.

verified_facts.text: The bungalows' decoration is a tribute to traditional Polynesian craftsmanship.
verified_facts.excerpt: You will appreciate the comfort of the bungalows, whose decoration is a tribute to traditional Polynesian craftsmanship.

verified_facts.text: Each bungalow has a terrace for relaxing, sunbathing or enjoying the starry sky.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each of the unique bungalows has a terrace where you can relax, sunbathe or enjoy the beautiful starry sky.

verified_facts.text: Accommodation categories include Overwater Bungalows, Villas with pool and Junior Suites with pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: – 20 Villas with pool

verified_facts.text: The hotel has an infinity pool facing the lagoon.
verified_facts.excerpt: just relax in the infinity pool facing the lagoon with its different shades blue

verified_facts.text: The Miki Miki Bar is built on stilts over the lagoon of Rangiroa.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Miki Miki Bar is built on stilts over the magnificent lagoon of Rangiroa.

verified_facts.text: Te Rairoa Restaurant blends Polynesian traditions and international cuisine, using local ingredients such as fresh fish, vanilla and Rangiroa honey.
verified_facts.excerpt: He uses tasty local ingredients, such as fresh fish and seafood, coconuts, local fruits, vanilla and Rangiroa honey.

verified_facts.text: A buffet and barbecue with a Polynesian dance show is held every Wednesday and Sunday night.
verified_facts.excerpt: Buffet / BBQ with Polynesian dance show every Wednesday & Sunday nights

verified_facts.text: The Poekura Spa, whose name means Pearl of Light in Tahitian, is set in the heart of the hotel's coconut grove.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Poekura Spa, which means “Pearl of Light” in Tahitian, is a true oasis of tranquility and relaxation

verified_facts.text: The spa has two massage bungalows with double cabins and the Vaimiti area, a Fare Pote with two Polynesian rain showers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Two bungalows for massages with double cabins and the Vaimiti area, a Fare Pote equipped with two Polynesian rain showers

verified_facts.text: The spa menu includes the traditional Polynesian massage, Taurumi.
verified_facts.excerpt: beauty treatments and the famous traditional Polynesian massage – Taurumi.

verified_facts.text: Spa therapists use Sothys products or the Poekura Spa's own oils made with Polynesian ingredients such as monoi, tamanu and vanilla.
verified_facts.excerpt: created with Polynesian ingredients such as monoi, tamanu, vanilla, coconut, mango and passion fruit

verified_facts.text: The hotel has the Aito Fitness Center in its coconut grove.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Aito Fitness Center is available at your convenience for your personal training

verified_facts.text: The Blue Velvet Diving Center is located at the hotel, and dives depart from the hotel's pontoon.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Blue Velvet Diving Center is located right at the Hotel Kia Ora Resort & Spa. Diving departures are made right from the hotel

verified_facts.text: Divers at Rangiroa can see dolphins, manta rays and grey sharks in tropical-temperature water all year round.
verified_facts.excerpt: You can observe dolphins, manta rays, grey sharks and many other species in tropical temperature water all year round.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's favorite excursions are the Blue Lagoon, Reef Island and drift snorkeling in the Tiputa pass.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our favorite excursions are: Blue Lagoon, Reef Island, and Drift snorkeling in the Tiputa pass.

verified_facts.text: Activities on the atoll include a Wine Cellar visit and dolphin watching.
verified_facts.excerpt: The atoll itself allows you to discover activities such as the Wine Cellar Tour and many others

verified_facts.text: The hotel recommends booking dives ahead of time.
verified_facts.excerpt: We highly recommend to book your dives ahead of time.

verified_facts.text: The Tuamotu atolls have no mountains and a much drier climate than the higher islands.
verified_facts.excerpt: They are called atolls and offer a much drier climate than the higher mountainous islands.

verified_facts.text: A dress code applies at the bar and restaurant; bathing suits are not allowed.
verified_facts.excerpt: For Lunch: Bathing suits are not allowed. T-shirts are permitted.
